pages.title: The Stands
pages.text: The candles became stands. On each I lay one thing, and when the stands hold a rite the altar knows, I begin. Four stands until the third tier, eight after.$(br2)Once I trusted it, I let hoppers lay the offerings, and the altar began by itself whenever they made a rite.

pages.title: The Chant
pages.text: When I begin a rite I step back and chant until it is done. Taking anything off a stand breaks the rite, and the essence comes back.$(br2)Each rite asks a tier, and many ask essence. Essence is the price of everything here. The next chapter is about nothing else.
